end.summary:
Compared distances by converting them to metres first.
Ordered three mixed-unit distances correctly in 3 attempts.
Found differences between distances correctly in 2 examples.
Initially compared numbers without matching units; corrected this later by converting to metres.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised converting kilometres and metres into the same unit before comparing, ordering distances, and finding differences. They used addition to convert mixed distances and checked answers with subtraction; an early mix-up about comparing 2 km and 500 m was corrected later in the lesson. At home, give two mixed-unit distances at a time and ask Arjun to convert both to metres before deciding which is longer.
